_comment: Endpoint blocks for the External REST path. resourcePath is relative to the tool's instance URL https://<host>/ords/<schema-alias>, so it starts with the module base path. ORDS path parameters (:name) are written {name}; tokens in resourcePath, headers or bodyTemplate are extracted as token parameters. Confirm field names against the base aistudio skill before creating the tool. See reference/ords-url-and-catalog.md
name: listTickets
description: List service tickets, newest first. Optional status filter (OPEN, IN_PROGRESS, RESOLVED). Paged: pass limit and offset and check hasMore.

name: getTicket
description: Fetch one service ticket by its reference, for example TKT-1001. Returns an enveloped collection with at most one item.

name: getSummary
description: Ticket counts - open, high priority and unassigned. Returns a bare JSON object with no items envelope.
